🐛 Apply keep/filter masks in structural operations and keep operands alive

After keep() or filter(), take, drop, cycle, reshape, flatten, keep,
filter, gather, match, chunk_by_reduce, pairs/enumerate and outer still
read the whole source array; chunk_by_reduce then writes past the end of
its result buffer, and pairs/enumerate read past the end of the other
operand. A masked argument to pairs, outer, cross, match, gather, keep or
replicate was read without its mask as well. Materialize masked arrays
first, as #124 did for map and map2.

gather, pairs and outer (and cross through pairs) also kept only the
receiver's storage, so a temporary argument was freed while the lazy
result still pointed at it. Keep both operands alive, as map2 does.
